title: Inherited shifts for exceptional transport realizations
statement: For the operation and left-realization families in the exceptional transport hypotheses, each supplied realization map has an integer shift-compatibility witness [lem-pur-normalized-reconstruction-adjunction-calculus].

proof.text: Use the inherited integer shifts on the operation and coefficient-inclusion functors together with the compact-support image shift, then transport the resulting shift across the supplied left-realization isomorphism.
The transported witnesses are indexed directly by RingStage, so finite and integral stages are covered uniformly and the resulting family is the leftShift field required by the core pre-data.

proof_origin.place: Construction 5.25; inheritance and transport of the integer shifts.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_exceptional_transport_left_shifts
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω]
    [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω] (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f)
    (operation : ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l, Operation.{u} l Ω X Y (s.stage l))
    (left : ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l,
      LeftRealization.{u} l Ω c s (operation s)) :
    ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l, (left s).hom.CommShift ℤ
